Draws the results for a direct shear test

Source: R/direct_shear_plots.R
direct_shear_plots.Rd

Draws the sigma-tau pairs along with the Mohr-Coulomb failure envelope for a set of direct shear lab test results, optionally with Mohr circles, and annotates the graph with the values of cohesion and friction angle.

Usage

DS_plot(sig.n, tau, units = "kPa")

DS_Mohr_plot(sig.n, tau, units = "kPa")

Arguments

sig.n

A numeric vector of the normal stress values

tau

A numeric vector of the shear stress values

units

A string with the units of the measurements

Value

A ggplot of the direct shear test results (DS_plot) or with the Mohr circles (DS_Mohr_plot)

References

Coduto, D. P. (1999). Geotechnical Engineering - Principles and Practices. Prentice Hall.

Holtz, R. D., Kovacs, W. D. & Sheahan, T. C. (2011). An Introduction to Geotechnical Engineering. Prentice Hall.

Gonzalez de Vallejo, L. I. (2004). Ingenieria Geologica. Prentice Hall.

See also

Other soil mechanics: Casagrande_LL(), Mohr_Circle(), bearing_capacity(), compaction_test(), fallcone_limits(), induced_stress(), insitu_stress(), particle_size_graph()

Examples

sig.n = c(80,237,395)
tau = c(127,345,475)
DS_plot(sig.n, tau)

DS_Mohr_plot(sig.n, tau)
